title: Widget settings help
summary: For the site owner: Help now describes the clearer Android widget settings screen and the new widget-list previews coming in Android 1.14.0.
items: The settings screen shows a live preview, names each choice in words, opens on the saved preset and applies a preset as soon as it is picked.
Save widget stays at the bottom; the extra app actions are in the ⋮ menu.
The Widgets list shows a sample healthy preview instead of "SIGN IN REQUIRED".
